description: Puts DUEL ARENA (the game's 2P DUEL) first on the title and hides TRADE. The decks come from the remote play pages (tools/remote-play) or the file MEMORIES_ARENA_DECKS names; with one for a side, the duel loads a save for it by itself, any card allowed (notes/duel-arena.md).
